results.pair_summary: Both documents define Basin of Attraction logic within the IR layer. Doc A specifies a foundational algorithmic approach using simple graph traversal and partition invariants. Doc B (v0.2) presents a comprehensive system specification that integrates Basin analysis with Trajectories, SCCs, and Stability thresholds, offering a richer type system.
results.integration_rationale: Doc B represents the evolved Chron-LLM architecture (v0.2) where attractors are derived from SCCs and stability metrics, rendering Doc A's simpler traversal-based logic insufficient for Delta3 Kernel requirements. To maintain a single source of truth and ensure temporal consistency, Doc A should be deprecated in favor of the integrated model defined in Doc B.
